summary: Nimbus is a self-hosted personal dashboard featuring a visual drag-and-drop editor and straightforward configuration files. It acts as a central hub to organise links and widgets for your various home server applications. The project is licensed under the AGPL-3.0 and is distributed as a container image.
goodFor: It suits users who want a customisable landing page for their homelab without manually writing YAML configuration files.
watchOut: The repository has a relatively low star count and a slowing maintenance cadence, meaning updates and bug fixes might be less frequent.
deployNotes: As a Docker-based application, you will typically need to map a persistent volume for configuration data and configure a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
